controles.affirmation: Les litiges amiante constituent 'le premier facteur de risque mentionne dans la section Item 1A du dernier rapport annuel'
controles.verbatim_source: ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS / Risks Relating to Our Business / 'General global economic and business conditions affect demand for our products.' est le premier facteur de risque. Le facteur amiante ('Our subsidiaries are party to asbestos-related litigation that could adversely affect our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.') arrive en 18e position environ, dans le bloc juridique et reglementaire, juste apres 'We are exposed to environmental, health and safety laws, liabilities and litigation.' (10-K FY2025)
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer la mention de rang, ou ecrire : 'facteur de risque juridique le plus detaille du 10-K, place dans le bloc des risques juridiques et reglementaires, avec environ 795 plaintes amiante en cours au 31 decembre 2025'.

controles.affirmation: Verbatim cite : 'Our subsidiaries are party to asbestos-related litigation that could adversely affect our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows related to asbestos matters.'
controles.verbatim_source: Le titre reel du facteur de risque s'arrete a '...results of operations and cash flows.' Le fragment 'related to asbestos matters' provient d'une phrase differente de l'Item 3 Legal Proceedings ('see Item 1A Risk Factors - [...] related to asbestos matters').
controles.correction_proposee: Citer le titre exact sans le fragment rapporte : 'Our subsidiaries are party to asbestos-related litigation that could adversely affect our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.'

controles.affirmation: La marge du segment Pool est tombee a 23,4%, 'sous la barre des 30% pour la premiere fois depuis 2022'
controles.verbatim_source: pool_margin history (kpis-haut/PNR.json, derive resultat segment / CA segment) : Q3-2023 = 29,3%. Egalement Q1-2022 26,7 / Q2-2022 29,5 / Q3-2022 28,0 / Q4-2022 29,1. La derniere occurrence sous 30% est donc le troisieme trimestre 2023.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : 'sous la barre des 30% pour la premiere fois depuis le troisieme trimestre 2023'.

controles.affirmation: Acquisition Taco 1,425 Md$ signee le 27 juillet 2026, facilite relais senior non garantie de 1,4 Md$, refinancement vise en qualite investissement, cloture attendue au T4 2026
controles.verbatim_source: On July 27, 2026 [...] we entered into a definitive agreement to acquire [...] Taco Group Holdings ('Taco'), for a purchase price of $1.425 billion [...] We expect to finance the acquisition with a combination of cash on hand and committed bridge financing, which we intend to refinance through a permanent debt issuance that we anticipate to be investment grade. controles.affirmation: La Cour supreme des Etats-Unis a invalide le 20 fevrier 2026 certains tarifs douaniers (IEEPA) ; Pentair a recu 34,9 M$ de remboursements au T2 2026 ; incertitude sur la recuperation des montants deja collectes
controles.verbatim_source: In addition, on February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court struck down certain tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Powers Act. It is unclear at this time what impact this decision will have on our future financial results, including whether we will be able to obtain refunds of amounts previously collected for such tariffs or the level of replacement tariffs the current U.S. Administration imposes through other means. (10-K FY2025) ; 'the positive impact of $34.9 million in refunds during the second quarter of 2026 associated with tariffs previously collected under IEEPA' (10-Q T2 2026, Gross profit)
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune. Precision facultative : le 10-K ecrit 'International Emergency Powers Act' (l'Item 1A ecrit 'International Emergency Economic Powers Act').
